effects: Pulls `amount` CYC OFT (the vault collateral 0x05E979…) from the signer into the vault via safeTransferFrom.
Credits vault active shares, computed from the amount actually received, to `onBehalfOf` (not necessarily the signer).
Reverts if the deposit whitelist is on and the signer is not whitelisted, or the deposit limit is exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 CYC OFT for the beneficiary address, with vault, amount and beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares credited to onBehalfOf is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); the result depends on vault state in storage, not on calldata.
findings.fix: None possible; optionally note in the intent that the beneficiary receives vault shares.

effects: Burns the signer's active vault shares worth `amount` CYC OFT (rounded up).
Queues `amount` CYC OFT into the next epoch's withdrawals and gives the withdrawal shares for that epoch to `claimer`.
No tokens move now; claimer can claim after the next epoch ends, and the queued amount can still be slashed before then.
formats.shown: Request 2.5 CYC OFT withdrawal for the claim-owner address, with vault, requested assets and claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the delay until claimable and the slashing risk on queued funds are not stated.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares; onSlash reduces withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]. Descriptor intent "Request withdrawal".
findings.fix: Optionally make the intent say 'Request withdrawal (claimable after next epoch)'.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of the signer's shares burned is derived from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake()).

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the CYC OFT they are worth (computed from storage) into the next epoch's withdrawals, with the withdrawal shares going to `claimer`.
No tokens move now; claimable after the next epoch ends, still subject to slashing.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claim-owner address, with vault, raw share count and claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw 18-digit integer without decimals.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` format "raw"; case 2 screen shows "987654321123456789". ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format "unit" with params {"decimals": 18, "base": "shares"} so it reads as 0.98765 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the CYC OFT amount the shares become is derived from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares()).

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Sends the signer's full withdrawal for that epoch, in CYC OFT (amount from storage), to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient address, with vault, epoch and recipient as fields.

findings.title: claim: the amount sent is read from storage and is not on screen.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender); claim: IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount).

findings.title: claim: the token sent (CYC OFT) is not named anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: descriptor claim intent "Claim withdrawal", interpolatedIntent "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}"; Vault.sol claim transfers `collateral`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Claim CYC OFT withdrawal" and the interpolated intent to "Claim CYC OFT from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}".

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Sends the sum of those withdrawals, in CYC OFT (amount from storage), to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient address, with each epoch and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount sent is read from storage and is not on screen.
claimBatch: the token sent (CYC OFT) is not named anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: descriptor claimBatch intent "Claim withdrawals", interpolatedIntent "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Claim CYC OFT withdrawals".
